name: Nine-region environment rebuild — regional landmark family
scope: Eight new surface landmark complexes. K09 has a separate Blender-authored hangar kit.
runtime: Pinned Three.js r164, opaque merged geometry, six shared materials, world-scale UVs
source: dist/exo-regional-landmarks.mjs; authored code geometry based on user-approved concept images

surface_sources.usage: Existing metal-color.jpg and packed metal normal/roughness; no new texture downloads
Existing panel-color.jpg and packed panel normal/roughness; scan modulation retains region palette

coordinates: Renderer uses fixed ExoRegionLandmarkData placements; same data supplies terrain pad and collision to physics and worker.
grounding: Seven sites use460-unit pads with80-unit blends. Mountain observatory uses350-unit pad and240-unit blend; its342-unit maximum radial geometry fits, and production grounded movement validates the mountain approach.
collision: 94 conservative boxes for major volumes, ring segments and domes. Small lamps, railings and field cases are visual dressing. Suspended volumes need height-aware collision.
validation: all terrain pads clear road navigation band, camps and cave entrances
open front approach clear for capsule, archive, minehead and deep shaft
all model bounds at least 1700 world units from active lethal boundaries
front approaches produce no guardian warning
mountain observatory elevation >=180 and grounded approach below slope1.1
limits: These are playable real-time interpretations of reference landmarks, not photorealistic replicas. Full game screenshots, flight/navigation regression and GPU frame-rate measurements belong to integration QA.
revision_notes: Reflector dishes have separately wound rear shell geometry for visibility from either approach; other painted surfaces remain single-sided.
Archive and observatory repositioned safely away from boundary guardian zones. All landmark geometry bounds and front approaches maintain >=1700 world-unit active-boundary clearance.
Observatory moved onto northern mountain eastern shoulder at(17600,2550), elevation300.6. Native slope0.378; broader blend avoids an abrupt summit cut.
